name: makeup.land
description: Israeli professional cosmetics retailer. REST API exposes the product catalog (with ΔE shade matching), customer wallet, cart, orders, gift cards, and registration. Bearer auth with scoped tokens; phone-keyed endpoints for cart and payment links.

vendor.name: א. ט. הפקות בע״מ / A.T. Hafakot Ltd.

tools.name: listProducts
tools.description: List products with filters: tag, brand, near_hex (ΔE shade match), hue_family, sort (price/popularity/rating/relevance). Returns ILS + ℳ-credit prices, swatches, ratings. Anonymous for catalog browse; bearer becomes required when passing phone=, include=inventory, or relevant_to_phone= (PII-keyed projections).

tools.name: listBrands
tools.description: List all brands with product counts and slugs. Bearer required.

tools.name: getCustomer
tools.description: Lookup a customer by phone (E.164). Returns tags, ℳ-credit balance, M Club tier. Bearer required.

tools.name: getCart
tools.description: Fetch a customer's most-recent cart by phone. Includes per-line and total reward projection. Bearer + phone are BOTH required: bearer authenticates the caller, phone selects the customer.

tools.name: addCartItem
tools.description: Add a product/variant to the customer's cart. Idempotent via Idempotency-Key. Stock-gated; credits-tender items wallet- gated. Bearer + phone (phone in body for POST).

tools.name: listOrders
tools.description: List a customer's recent orders with payment status. Bearer required.

tools.name: validateGiftCard
tools.description: Public endpoint — check a gift card's remaining balance without revealing the full code. Gated on knowledge of the code itself; no bearer required.

tools.name: registerCustomer
tools.description: Generic registration orchestrator — create or look up a customer, compute tags, fire WhatsApp template + partner webhooks. Scope: register.
